notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) is at completion stage 2, with 25 written subpages (about 109,000 characters). The walkthrough has written pages for every main step in its contents: Great Plateau, Sheikah Allies, the four Divine Beasts, The Master Sword, Sheikah Slate Memories and Hyrule Castle, plus The Trial of the Sword and The Champion's Ballad. The Walkthrough index page is short (about 1,400 characters) and Sidequests is thin (about 700). Of the 15 region towers only Great Plateau Tower and Dueling Peaks Tower have written pages, Shrines pages exist for four towers, and no Korok seed pages are written; Shrine Index, Equipment, Ingredients, Recipes, Flora and Fauna, Amiibo and DLC are listed but not written. Gameplay, Controls, Combat, Enemies and Weapons are written. Chapters follow the contents order, with pairs of Divine Beasts grouped; titles were reworded and no text was copied. The contents page has a typo linking "Lake Tower Tower/Shrines". zelda.fandom.com answers the API, but the title redirects to the project page "Zelda Wiki:The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild" (about 207 article links), not a normal article, so its link count should not be relied on. Nintendo Switch 2 appears in the StrategyWiki categories but not in RAWG's platform list.
